fieldValues.title: manifest.container is required and satisfies core Container invariants 20-21
fieldValues.normative_statement: The root Container MUST satisfy the core Container invariants unchanged: Invariant 20 (its `containerId` is not an instance ID and never appears as an entry `instanceId` in `memberInstanceIds`, nor in `Relation.sourceInstanceId` or `Relation.targetInstanceId`) and Invariant 21 (every entry's `instanceId` in `memberInstanceIds` references a valid SRS instance id). `rootInstanceIds` is removed ([R4]).
